noveltyJustification: 4 of 7 findings consolidate prior evidence; the citation audit, the draft ranking and the uncertainty register are new.

label: Citation audit clean: 65 source tag pairs (60 unique) across iterations 1-8 resolve by file existence and line range.
One mechanism recurs in every class: a derivable value is stored, and its re-mint is triggered by a check on a different surface or cadence than the edit (10 counted instances).
Three prevention planes hold the checks — commit-time hook, CI, doctor/manual — and each class's checks sit on the plane furthest from the edit.
A lexical split compounds it: author-visible vocabularies (description.json, ROUTER.md) are not the consumed vocabulary (graph-metadata via graph/SQLite), and counter-signals have no lane.

One root-cause statement covers all five classes: authoring and consumed surfaces are separated by generated copies, inert vocabularies and mismatched check cadence; the smallest universal fix attaches existing checks to surfaces the author already touches.

Draft phase ranking: P1 pre-commit extension (E1+E5, one file), P2 advisor vocabulary/reindex wiring (E3), P3 changelog bump command + warn-set values (E2), P4 surfaceHint pass-through (E4), P5 external validator entry (E1/E2 for standalone users).

Uncertainty register: the merge collision is packet-stated only; the intent-signals check has no caller found by search; the battery was not run live; trigger-index staleness is expected mid-branch; the warn lists are deliberate.
